disclosure: Sessions are procedurally generated (feature_engineering/generate_behavior_sessions.py), not captured from real users. Each dataset row is one independent session, so the row-level split used by model/train.py carries no cross-session feature leakage. 100% test accuracy reflects clean synthetic class separation, not real-world performance. Replace with real labelled browser sessions before reporting production accuracy.
split: random 80/20 row split (equivalent to session-level split; one row per session)
known_limitations: Synthetic data only; no real user sessions collected yet.
Binary Keyboard/Mouse classes only; idle/mixed states not modelled.
Class separation is clean by construction, so accuracy will not transfer to noisy real sessions without re-collection and re-training.
